films.cast: George MacKay, Callum Turner, Rosalind Eleazar, Mary Woodvine
films.description: Cornish auteur Mark Jenkin returns with a political folktale of two fishermen locked in a time-loop.

films.title: Secret Scandal
films.cast: Monica Vitti, Elliott Gould, Catherine Spaak
films.description: Monica Vitti’s sole venture into directing is a bravura reflection on female identity.

films.title: Ish
films.cast: Farhan Hasnat, Yahya Kitana, Joy Crookes
films.description: A coming-of-age story for modern times, this powerful British debut explores the emotional cost of racism on our children.

films.title: The Shining (Extended Version)
films.cast: Jack Nicholson, Shelley Duvall, Scatman Crothers
films.description: Stanley Kubrick’s nightmarish horror benefits hugely from its constructed backdrop: The Overlook Hotel.

films.title: Snowpiercer
films.cast: Chris Evans, Song Kang-ho, Tilda Swinton, Octavia Spencer
films.description: Bong Joon Ho’s first English language feature is a post-apocalyptic adventure set aboard an unstoppable train whose class-divided carriages stoke the fires of revolution.

films.title: Some Like It Hot

films.description: Marilyn Monroe sizzles opposite Tony Curtis and Jack Lemmon in Billy Wilder’s genre-melding comic masterpiece.

films.title: Sound and Vision: Films by Helen Petts
films.description: A screening of films by the acclaimed filmmaker followed by a discussion of her work.

films.title: Somewhere
films.cast: Stephen Dorff, Elle Fanning
films.description: Sofia Coppola’s second film set in a hotel finds a jaded Hollywood star re-connecting with the world through his relationship with his daughter.

films.title: Stardust
films.cast: Monica Vitti, Alberto Sordi, Wanda Osiris
films.description: Monica Vitti and Alberto Sordi, in their last on-screen pairing, shine in this bittersweet comic musical.

films.description: Billed as a new kind of American movie, Jim Jarmusch’s hugely impressive second feature leans into Ozu, Bresson and the avant-garde.

films.title: Strings
films.description: This extraordinary film features a stunningly realised world whose occupants’ lives literally hang from a thread.

films.title: To Catch a Thief
films.cast: Cary Grant, Grace Kelly
films.description: The sunlit French Riviera becomes the backdrop for Alfred Hitchcock’s thriller, pairing a suave Cary Grant and sparkling Grace Kelly.

films.title: Tosca
films.cast: Monica Vitti, Vittorio Gassman, Gigi Proietti
films.description: Monica Vitti and Vittorio Gassman are perfectly paired in this uniquely Roman retelling of Tosca.

films.title: Trains!
films.description: A vital selection of British shorts looking at how train travel has transformed over the course of 200 years.

films.title: The Undeclared War Series 2
films.cast: Simon Pegg, Hannah Khalique-Brown, Siân Brooke
films.description: Join us for the return of Channel 4’s immense international cyberwarfare thriller.

films.title: The Universal Clock: The Resistance of Peter Watkins
films.description: A fascinating and illuminating overview of Watkins’ radical theories and uncompromising approach to cinema.

tags: System Critical: The Radical Films of Peter Watkins

films.title: Vigil Series 3: Episode 1
films.cast: Suranne Jones, Rose Leslie, Gary Lewis
films.description: The foreboding icy tundra of the arctic is the backdrop for series three of the BBC’s pulse-racing thriller.

films.title: Vagabond
films.cast: Sandrine Bonnaire, Macha Méril, Yolande Moreau
films.description: Agnès Varda’s tale of what happened to a solitary hitchhiker is told in flashback, through the experiences of those who came into contact with her.

films.title: Waiting to Exhale
films.cast: Whitney Houston, Angela Bassett, Loretta Devine, Lela Rochon
films.description: This cultural touchstone, and superb romantic comedy, features standout performances by Whitney Houston and Angela Bassett.

films.title: Lone Wolves
films.cast: Matt Foss, Cora Vander Broek
films.description: In this knockout indie comedy, an impeccably planned DIY self-insemination operation between old friends causes more than one kind of discharge.

films.title: What Could Have Been: Something’s Got to Give
films.description: An illustrated talk examining the background of Marilyn Monroe’s final, unfinished film.

films.title: Joybubbles
films.description: A blind hacker genius creates a new subculture and chooses child-like wonder in this astounding documentary.

films.title: What Did You Eat Today? Rose Lowder
films.description: French-Peruvian filmmaker Rose Lowder prepares and eats a meal in the first of a series of beguiling films that trace the echoes of action in unexpected places.

films.title: D-Punk
films.cast: Celeste Bell, Jemima Dury, Penny Pepper, Mat Fraser, Mik Scarlet
films.description: A raw, defiant documentary where punk and disability collide – challenging norms, reclaiming space, and rewriting who gets to be seen and heard.

films.title: Yonderland
films.description: The fantasy world of Yonderland receives a visit from Birmingham’s Debbie Maddox, who some of the residents believe to be the ‘Chosen One’.

films.title: White Snow
films.cast: Madhu Kandhari, Bhavya Khurana, Kachoo Ahmad Khan
films.description: A stirring and powerful political drama that follows a mother’s journey through the Kashmir Himalayan peaks to screen her son’s film, which has been banned by fanatics and the state for the absurd reason of causing social unrest.
